candid: Small sensor, everything at every distance equally in focus and nothing softened, sensor noise in the shadows, washed-out colour, slight motion blur, off-center and slightly tilted framing, no studio lighting and no colour grading. She wears her hair loose, with a few strands pushed behind one ear.
directed: Full-frame camera on a tripod, sharp where it is focused and softly out of focus behind, deep clean shadows, true colour and no grain, the frame square and level. She wears her hair loose, with a few strands pushed behind one ear.
